notes.title: RELEASE THE KITTENS! - New map, performance increases, UI updates and release!
notes.content:
[b][h1][u]KITTEN RAMPAGE 1.10 Release[/u][/h1][/b]
[b]Mega-Meowww![/b]
Kitten Rampage leaves early access with its latest map addition: [b]Desert Getaway[/b]

[img]http://www.kittenrampage.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/LoadingImageDesertGetaway.png[/img]

[h1][u][b]NOTES:[/b][/u][/h1]
Added Desert Getaway Time Trial and Free-roam maps
New props and objects setup and programmed for map addition
Updated to in-game HUD (lots of back-end improvements and settings to animation and Animators)
Fixes and updates to UI
Resolution fixes and aspect ratio parameters updates (should fix the resolution and blurry screen bug that quite a few players were getting!)
Added desert style assets (bushes/trees/rocks) for the latest themed map
Back-end game engine code and settings improved + tweaked for maximum performance and frame rate
Added language and death / violence warning to Store pages
Added Current weapon text above weapon hot-bar


[img]http://i.imgur.com/dVHqkNW.png[/img]

A big thank you to our players and kitten fans for your support and feedback!

If you encounter any problems with OS X or Linux versions please contact support or chat with us on our forums!

[h1][b]Questions or feedback?[/b][/h1]
Connect with us and other kittens!
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/434360/discussions][b]Kitten Rampage Steam Forums[/b][/url]
developers@kittenrampage.com
Twitter - [url=http://www.twitter.com/kittenrampage]@KittenRampage[/url]

notes.title: HALLOWEEN SPECIAL! Kittens, Spiders, and Pumpkin Hunt!
notes.content:
[b][h1][u]KITTEN RAMPAGE HALLOWEEN[/u][/h1][/b]
[b]Boooo-Meow Kittens![/b]
We have pushed out the Halloween 2016 Special Map! + Our most recent update for Kitten Rampage! 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/C062bUS.jpg[/img]
[h1][u][b]HALLOWEEN UPDATE:[/b][/u][/h1]
[b]*NEW* - Fur Factory Spooky Halloween Edition Map[/b]
[b]*NEW* - Fur Factory Halloween Objectives[/b]
[b]*FIX* - Alt Camera not working for certain users[/b]
[b]*UPDATE* - Updates to core functions and runtime optimization[/b]

[h1][u][b]LATEST UPDATES:[/b][/u][/h1]
[b]NEW/Upgraded[/b] -FLUFFY WEAPONRY!
[list]In-game:
[*]Eye-beams of cuteness (lasers)
[*]Chewy Chain Gun (rapid fire chain gun)
[*]9 Lives launcher (kitten rocket launcher)
[*]Hairy Hairballs (rapid fire hairball puking/spitting)
[/list]
[b]NEW! -[/b]Added new UI hot-bar for weapon selection and switching
[b]Upgraded[/b] - UI Updated for new weapons control options (using 1, 2,3 and 4 keys to cycle through weapons)
[b]Upgraded[/b] - Big Updates to Progress on Full Controller Compatibility! (Plays best with Microsoft Xbox based controllers)
[b]Upgraded[/b] - Optimization of core game components and code works
[b]Upgraded[/b] - Controls Updates for new weaponry
[b]Upgraded[/b] - Updates to controls info in the main menu and help menus
[b]Upgraded[/b] - Updated and optimized to collision on certain props
[b]Upgraded[/b] - Updated wiki with detailed game info (weapon info, damage, maps, hints, etc.)
(Still a W.I.P.)
[b]Fixed[/b] - Removed and replaced some laggy props from game

[b]COMING IN NEXT CORE UPDATE:[/b]
New! Mouse House Map & Objectives
New! Additional Steam Achievements across the board!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/dVHqkNW.png[/img]

A big thank you for your ongoing support and feedback during early access!

If you encounter any problems with new OS X or Linux versions please contact support or chat with us on our forums!

notes.title: Community Update: TRADING CARDS, BADGES, EMOTICONS, AVATARS AND BACKGRDOUNDS! + MAC OS X and LINUX FIX / PATCH - 0.151 Patch
notes.content:
[b][h1][u]KITTEN RAMPAGE COMMUNITY UPDATE! + 0.151 from earlier[/u][/h1][/b]

[b]Greetings fellow kittens![/b]
We have officially released our first round of community items!

Kitten Rampage trading cards, badges emoticons, avatars and profile background are now available!

Trading cards will dropping if your game is open while you reek havoc!

Older:
[h1]Update 0.151 is available for all Kittens! This updated included the following below change log updates, fixed, and new maps/gamemodes![/h1] 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/QWIQIAi.png[/img]

[h1][u][b]LATEST FEATURES / UPDATES:[/b][/u][/h1]
[b]Added[/b] - Catfish Corner - Time Trial Map and Challenges!
[b]Added[/b] - Catfish Corner - Free Roam Map and Challenges!
[b]Added[/b] - Add/Updated Play menu level images and selections
[b]Major[/b] - Change / Version Update to game engine
[b]Upgraded[/b] - Improved loading times on all levels
[b]Upgraded[/b] - Menu and back end HUD optimizations
[b]Fixed[/b] - Fixed fur factory music and game audio codecs
[b]Fixed[/b] - UI Fix for picking up / using health and med kits
[b]Fixed[/b] - Offline Player Steam Achievements Not Unlocking (now working offline)
[b]Fixed[/b] - Some levels not completing after all objectives were achieved
[b]Fixed[/b] - Survival level(s) objectives were not completing (fixed)

[b]Known bug:[/b] Some players are experiencing trees not loading on their first level chosen to play! Reloading the level or loading into another level fixes this problem.

A big thank you for your ongoing support and feedback during early access!

If you encounter any problems with new OS X or Linux versions please contact support or chat with us on our forums!

notes.title: Customize Your Kitten! - Major Update 0.148 + 0.147!
notes.content:
[img] http://i.imgur.com/URSSMYG.gif [/img]

[h1][b]SO MEOWSOME! UPDATE 0.148![/b][/h1]

[b][u]Hello felines![/u]

We are please to release this customization update for Kitten Rampage! 
Update 0.148 will be live today on all platforms for all kittens![/b] (Thursday, March 17th, 2016)

[b]You can now use the profile screen to track your kittens stats and also customize your kitten![/b]

New fur colors can be unlocked by playing and completing the new Fur Factory maps!

[img] http://i.imgur.com/dVHqkNW.png [/img]

[b][u][h1]PREVIOUS MAJOR UPDATE:[/h1][/u]
Below you will find a detailed change log for 0.147![b]

[b][u]PLEASE NOTE:[/u][/b] Kitten controls have been improved and changed! You may now use your mouse to steer and shoot, then using W,A,S, and D to control your Kitten's rotation moment! Pressing the LEFT ALT key on your keyboard will switch between new controls and the old!

[h1][u]NEW // IMPROVEMENTS[/u][/h1]
-NEW MAPS and MODES! FUR FACTORY! New props, new terrain + fun environment!
*Fur Factory Glass windows can be broken for points!*
-NEW GAME MODES! - Time Trial, Expert Mode, Survival and Free Roam! All Included!
-NEW ENEMIES! - New hostile enemies, more coming soon, better AI optimization!
-ALL NEW VEHICLES! Kittens can now run over hostile enemies and props while raging!
-NEW POWER UPS! A new "Increased Speed" power up is available in all Expert Mode levels! Run faster, rampage harder! (more game boosts coming soon)
-Added In Options Menu (Main Menu) - New check-box for muting songs!
-Added In Options Menu (Main Menu) - New check-box for HUD Hints!
-Added In Options Menu (Main Menu) - New check-box for Help popup windows!
-Added In Options Menu (Main Menu) - Kitten name now saving to your profile!
-Added a counter for number of enemy agents and hostiles killed in every map!
-Added more med-kits + particles effects
-Animated doors when kitten gets close enough (Map specific)
-New loading screen graphics and PLAY Menu level selections
-New/updated trailer for Steam store page!


[h1][u]CHANGES[/u][/h1]
-UPGRADED GRENADES! Puking smelly grenades now does proper damage to enemies! (Caution: Grenades can be very laggy)
-With new vehicles - Improved physics, sounds, and an overall fun experience!
-UPDATED! Steam Store Page images and misc. graphics.
-Free look mouse control camera is now the main camera!
-Increased Eyeball Lasers projectile speed!
-Updated In Game Pause Menu graphics/buttons for better legibility.
-Updated Options Menu (Main Menu and In game) - New video options, better optimized back-end settings.
-Updated UI Animations and style when killing agents or hostile enemies
-Updated shaders and quality options!
-Updated Play Menu Images and level arrangement
-Increased enemy Agents health! A little harder to eliminate!
-Updated to new shaders on most props for optimization (frame rate increase)
-Timer for each enemy killed reduced for balancing and a harder challenge!
-Updated lighting indoor/outdoor variants
-Updated graphics settings and defaults - Ultra is now default for video settings.
-Kitten run and sprint animations reworked to match actual speed.
-Kitten run and sprint speed increased slightly (faster action!)

[h1][u]FIXES[/u][/h1]
-Play Menu scroll speed increased/fixed! Now properly scrolls.
-Fixed Audio Engine Bug - Explosion sounds would not play at a distance (now fixed!)
-Fixed Audio Engine Bug - Explosion and destruction clips not playing or cutting short (now fixed!)
-Fixed objectives system - Would not reset when reloading the level
-Movement system tweaks - When not using the mouse controls: Kitten has less of a wide turning radius!
-Agents Hideout Lighting Updated/Changed for better frame rate (Map Optimization)
-Fixed "Level Locked" Text Placement on Play menu tab

[h1][u]UPCOMING[/u][/h1]
-The "Hostiles AND Weaponry Update. Another great content update with new weapons, new enemies/AI and fun activities!
-Steam Trading Cards, Emoticons, Badges, Avatars, and community items!
-New additional fun Steam achievements! 
-More polish and awesome fixes (Survival modes will be optimized more)


A big thank you for your ongoing support and feedback during early access!

[h1][b]Questions or feedback?[/b][/h1]
Connect with us and other kittens!
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/434360/discussions][b]Kitten Rampage Steam Forums[/b][/url]
developers@kittenrampage.com
